name: insight-os
description: Evidence-linked customer, sales coaching, and market intelligence workflows backed by the read-only Insight OS MCP catalog.

interface.shortDescription: Turn customer-call evidence into scoped sales and market intelligence.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the read-only Insight OS capability catalog and adds focused workflows for pre-call customer context, sales coaching, market comparison, and evidence-backed claim verification. Authorization, row scope, PII redaction, and cohort privacy remain enforced by Insight OS on every tool call.
